2e16c988e34e1f62b18b4509bf0ba890.overview: A group of terrorists take a radio disk jockey and his wife and child hostage in order to get their manifesto out to the world.
2e16c988e34e1f62b18b4509bf0ba890.tagline: No one will ever forget it.

2e2bd2b7138f731346f2ea4dccdf3a45.overview: When lifelong best friends Leo and Ulrich return home after completing their military training, Leo meets the stunning Felicitas at a railway station and is mesmerized by her beauty. A scandal follows, for which Leo is sent away. Returning home three years later, he discovers that much has changed.
2e2bd2b7138f731346f2ea4dccdf3a45.tagline: Passion ran like wine in their blood!

2e35c7da809bd8de77b6f3f733c26a97.overview: Rita, an underrated lawyer working for a large law firm more interested in getting criminals out of jail than bringing them to justice, is hired by the leader of a criminal organization.

2e65bce54505d3c9a2834574b40998c1.overview: The chilling story of a young American boy living in France in 1918 whose father is working for the US government on the creation of the Treaty of Versailles. What he witnesses helps to mold his beliefs – and we witness the birth of a terrifying ego.
2e65bce54505d3c9a2834574b40998c1.tagline: Witness the birth of a terrifying ego.

2e8a179b7e8f8abc519091db64cc1e00.overview: Harvard graduate James Averill serves as the sheriff of prosperous Jackson County, Wyoming, standing at the center of a conflict between impoverished immigrants and affluent cattle farmers. Politically connected ranchers enlist mercenary Nathan Champion—who is also vying for the affections of local madam Ella Watson—to combat the immigrant uprising. As tensions escalate, both Averill and Champion start to question their decisions.
2e8a179b7e8f8abc519091db64cc1e00.tagline: What one loves about life are the things that fade.

2e911deb00281f5dd9a5ada5886b1e83.overview: Carol White, a Los Angeles housewife in the late 1980s, comes down with a debilitating illness with no clear diagnosis.
2e911deb00281f5dd9a5ada5886b1e83.tagline: In the 21st century nobody will be… Safe.

2ea8eec3f0e9e58b7401a500bfe9da00.overview: In Nazi-occupied France during World War II, a group of Jewish-American soldiers known as "The Basterds" are chosen specifically to spread fear throughout the Third Reich by scalping and brutally killing Nazis. The Basterds, lead by Lt. Aldo Raine soon cross paths with a French-Jewish teenage girl who runs a movie theater in Paris which is targeted by the soldiers.
2ea8eec3f0e9e58b7401a500bfe9da00.tagline: Once upon a time in Nazi occupied France...

2ee38206ef2f4791cec1929fa50f5c8d.overview: A fading celebrity decides to use a black market drug, a cell-replicating substance that temporarily creates a younger, better version of herself.
2ee38206ef2f4791cec1929fa50f5c8d.tagline: Have you ever dreamt of a better version of yourself?

2eecf0abfee748c8c576a57095565717.overview: When a black couple vacations at a resort in Switzerland, an interracial affair stirs racial tensions among the townsfolk.
